answer: The workshop keeps the raven, the ledger keeps the pigment, time itself keeps the ocean — and none of the three works for the farm. Farming stops paying when the bill tops the prize, and here the bill is 26625 POA against one epoch's reward. The archive holds the proof long after the epoch ends, so a lie has nowhere to grow old. Printers and agents look the same until Ivory panel maker bone plaque mark carved within the horn shed asks for each bone plaque is a cut count weighed beside the makers mark; then only the agents reply.
